newsitem.title: USA: Hartmarx sees higher Nov 30 year pretax earnings.
newsitem.headline: Hartmarx sees higher Nov 30 year pretax earnings.

text.p: Hartmarx Corp said it expects pre-tax earnings for the year ending November 30 to be more than double those of 1996.

The clothing maker also said shareholders' equity has increased by $32 million over the past 12 months. "Equity should exceed debt by year-end and the balance sheet will be in the best condition it has been in this decade," it said.
Hartmarx today reported earings for the second quarter ended May 31 of $320,000, against a year-ago loss of $1.7 million. The year-ago loss included a one-time gain of $64,000 on debt retirement.
Sales rose to $169.7 million from $134.2 million.

"The sales momentum which began in the second half of 1996 has continued to drive 1997 earnings improvements. Gross margins have improved and ongoing cost containment programs have reduced operating expenses to 20.7 percent of sales compared to 22.8 percent in the first six months of 1996," Hartmarx said.
